HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. APARESH KUMAR SINGH  ORDER 11/12//2024 IA No.01 of 2024 in Crl. Rev.P. No.76 of 2024 Mr. Raju Datta, learned Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State.

The learned Additional Sessions Judge, North Tripura, Dharmanagar has upheld the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 26.07.2023 passed by learned Asst. Sessions Judge,
Dharmangar, North Tripura in ST(T-2) 26 of 2021 whereby the petitioner was convicted under Sections 498A/306 of the IPC.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text:
Asst. Sessions Judge,
Dharmangar, North Tripura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a term of 2(two) years along with fine of Rs.5000/- and a default sentence under Section 498A of the IPC and further sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a term of 3(three) years along with fine of Rs.5,000/- and a default sentence under Section 306 of the IPC.
Both the sentences shall run concurrently.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has approached this Court under Section 397 read with Section 401 of Cr.P.C.
Mr. D. Sarkar, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the impugned judgment suffers from several material errors and appreciation of evidence.
Therefore, petitioner has approached this Court in revision.
He submits that pending hearing of this revision petition the prayer for suspension of sentence may be allowed.

Upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties and after considering the materials placed from records and taking into view the sentence of two years and three years respectively imposed and upheld up to the appellate Court, this Court is inclined to allow the prayer for suspension of sentence made by the petitioner subject to furnishing bail bond of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five Md. Taslim Uddin vs The State Of Tripura on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27797468/
1 thousand) only with two sureties of like amount each before the learned Trial Court.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No.01/2024 stands disposed of.
The revision petition is admitted for hearing.
Call for the lower court records from the concerned court.
Office to prepare Paper Book after receipt of lower court records.
Matter be listed for hearing in usual course.
